input.from: UTF-8 JSON, or Markdown for memory append
input.amendment: JSON Merge Patch of editable fields

commands.effect: Create project configuration and install the embedded assets; preserve existing project content.
commands.basis: 07 §§5–7; exact options selected by this template

commands.effect: Apply the binary's embedded guidance snapshot using per-file bases; --accept acknowledges an explicitly resolved pending candidate.
commands.basis: 07 §§5–7; conflict-resolution option selected by this template

commands.effect: Explicitly migrate supported persisted project formats; keep identities and relationships.
Describe resolved project/host paths and metadata-view state without disclosing credentials or writing objects.
commands.basis: 04 §7; 06 §2; exact diagnostic name selected by this template

commands.effect: Allocate a Model identity and associate an existing Git repository or program scope.
Set this host's checkout binding for a known Model.

commands.usage: accrete model iteration open MODEL_ID --from FILE
commands.effect: Describe an iteration, attaching an existing checkout or creating an explicitly requested Model worktree.

commands.usage: accrete model iteration close ITERATION_ID --from FILE --expect REVISION
commands.effect: Retain the outcome and selected commits; merging and worktree removal remain native actions.
Give an existing capability a Tool identity and explicit live or retained source selection.

commands.usage: accrete tool update TOOL_ID --from FILE --expect REVISION
commands.effect: Amend metadata or source selection without changing the user's active implementation checkout.

commands.usage: accrete tool expose TOOL_ID --host codex|claude [--name NAME] [--mode wrapper|symlink]
commands.effect: Create a project-local discovery binding to actual source material; default to a portable source-reading wrapper.
Refresh existing managed bindings, reporting unavailable or pending source material.

commands.usage: accrete tool retire TOOL_ID --from FILE --expect REVISION
commands.effect: Retain identity and associations while ending normal discovery; preserve source material and running work.
Create an explicit capability export at a chosen destination; external publication remains a separate action.
Describe Data and usable locations without mandatory payload copying, packing or hashing.

commands.usage: accrete data register --name NAME --path PATH --kind file|directory [--result RESULT_ID]
commands.effect: Register a local borrowed path through the architecture's convenience form.

commands.usage: accrete data location add DATA_ID --location NAME --path PATH [--host HOST]
commands.effect: Add a locator for the same described content; do not redefine earlier Result inputs.

commands.usage: accrete data materialize DATA_ID --to LOCATION [--source SOURCE_LOCATION]
commands.effect: Produce and publish a managed replica using local transfer or the configured rclone adapter.
Remove precisely one Kernel-managed replica while preserving the Data identity and other locations.
Persist a useful activity description and its supplied Model, Tool and Data associations.

commands.usage: accrete result amend RESULT_ID --from FILE --expect REVISION
commands.effect: Apply an explicit correction or enrichment against the actual current document bytes.

commands.usage: accrete result observe RESULT_ID --text-file FILE [--operation-id UUID]
commands.effect: Append an independent observation; an optional operation ID makes retries unambiguous.

commands.usage: accrete memory append --from FILE [--id UUID] [--operation-id UUID] [--model ID] [--tool ID] [--data ID] [--result ID] [--memory ID]
commands.effect: Publish complete authored Markdown with a stable ID, timezone-based path and repeatable object links.

receipt.multi_effects: enumerate actual written paths and any pending projections/exposures
receipt.index_pending: primary publication succeeded; exit 0; repair with index refresh
receipt.published_uncertain: published=true, durability=uncertain, object ID/path and recovery details; distinct nonzero status
receipt.error: stable category plus committed/published state and surviving paths; numeric nonzero codes chosen by CLI
